Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_222975.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_222975.v · Open raw
module origen_222975 (
    input sys_clk,
    input sys_rst,
    input [13:0] csr_a,
    input csr_we,
    input [31:0] csr_di,
    inout [3:0] mc_d,
    input mc_cmd,
    output mc_clk,
    output [31:0] csr_do
);

reg [3:0] mc_d_reg;
reg mc_clk_reg;
reg [31:0] csr_do_reg;

reg [6:0] state;
reg [31:0] cmd_reg;
reg [31:0] data_reg;
reg [31:0] csr_reg [0:63];

parameter IDLE = 7'b0000001;
parameter SEND_CMD = 7'b0000010;
parameter RECEIVE_RESP = 7'b0000100;
parameter SEND_DATA = 7'b0001000;
parameter RECEIVE_DATA = 7'b0010000;
parameter UPDATE_CSR = 7'b0100000;
parameter ERROR = 7'b1000000;

always @(posedge sys_clk or posedge sys_rst) begin
    if (sys_rst) begin
        state <= IDLE;
        mc_d_reg <= 4'b0;
        mc_clk_reg <= 1'b0;
        cmd_reg <= 32'b0;
        data_reg <= 32'b0;
        csr_do_reg <= 32'b0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (csr_we) begin
                    csr_reg[csr_a] <= csr_di;
                    state <= UPDATE_CSR;
                end else begin
                    state <= SEND_CMD;
                end
            end
            SEND_CMD: begin
                if (cmd_reg[31:24] == 8'haa) begin
                    mc_d_reg <= cmd_reg[7:4];
                    mc_clk_reg <= 1'b1;
                    cmd_reg <= {cmd_reg[23:0], 8'b0};
                    if (cmd_reg[31:24] == 8'b0) begin
                        state <= RECEIVE_RESP;
                    end
                end else begin
                    state <= ERROR;
                end
            end
            RECEIVE_RESP: begin
                mc_d_reg <= 4'b0;
                mc_clk_reg <= 1'b0;
                data_reg <= {data_reg[27:0], mc_d};
                if (data_reg[31:24] == 8'hbb) begin
                    state <= SEND_DATA;
                end else begin
                    state <= ERROR;
                end
            end
            SEND_DATA: begin
                mc_d_reg <= data_reg[7:4];
                mc_clk_reg <= 1'b1;
                data_reg <= {data_reg[27:0], 4'b0};
                if (data_reg[31:24] == 8'b0) begin
                    state <= RECEIVE_DATA;
                end
            end
            RECEIVE_DATA: begin
                mc_d_reg <= 4'b0;
                mc_clk_reg <= 1'b0;
                data_reg <= {data_reg[27:0], mc_d};
                if (data_reg[31:24] == 8'hcc) begin
                    state <= IDLE;
                end else begin
                    state <= ERROR;
                end
            end
            UPDATE_CSR: begin
                csr_do_reg <= csr_reg[csr_a];
                state <= IDLE;
            end
            ERROR: begin
                state <= IDLE;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

assign mc_d = (state == SEND_CMD || state == SEND_DATA) ? mc_d_reg : 4'bZ;
assign mc_clk = mc_clk_reg;
assign csr_do = csr_do_reg;

endmodule
